projects.title: Listo Para Llevar
projects.description:
Listo para Llevar is a web application designed to connect businesses with surplus food items to consumers interested in purchasing these products at reduced prices. The primary goal of the platform is to minimize food waste while generating additional income for businesses and providing sustainable and cost-effective options for consumers.

The user experience has been designed to be intuitive and accessible, focusing on simplicity and efficiency to enable users, both consumers and businesses, to achieve their goals quickly and effectively.
